text_block_list.text:
One day, Hokko Tarumae asked me to help
her brainstorm PR plans for her hometown, Tomakomai.
choice_data_list: I'm not super familiar with Tomakomai, though...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that's even better!
I wanted to get an outside perspective!
Please...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright, to start off,
let me give you a quick rundown
of the basics of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
First up is "Tomachop-san"!
He's the official mascot of Tomakomai City...
choice_data_list: Ah, I've actually seen him before.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Really!?
You already knew about him...? I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Umm, next up...
Let me tell you about "hascup"!
choice_data_list: I know about hascup, too.
I know about hascup, too!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list: Come to think of it...

text_block_list.text:
"Surf clams", "Yoitomake", "Mount Tarumae"...
The various keywords listed in her proposal...
choice_data_list: I might have seen all of these before?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that true!?
Waaah~~~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you know so much!
Could it be that you've been to Tomakomai before!?
choice_data_list: Eh... Didn't you teach me all of this?
Eh... Didn't you tell me all about them?

text_block_list.text:
I recall one day after an exhibition race,
watching Hokko Tarumae enthusiastically promoting
hascup while catching her breath.

Even after that, every time she won a race,
she would relentlessly promote Tomakomai.
So many times that it naturally stuck in my head.
choice_data_list: I learned it all from your promotions.
I learned it all from your activities.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
From my... activities...
—My message really got through...
choice_data_list: Your fans probably know even more than I do.
Your fans are probably even more knowledgeable.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—! That's right!
They even watch my concerts and live shows, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In that case, maybe we can do so much more
with our PR plans...!
choice_data_list: Then... why not ask them for help right from this stage?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Let's promote Tomakomai together, everyone♪
We're eagerly waiting for your ideas!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Brainstorming projects together with fans.
I never would have thought of that... hm?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eh, already so many notifications...!
It's spreading at incredible speed!?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai PR together with Tarumae-chan!
Waaah~, I've been waiting for something like this!

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
As a fan, I really want to visit in person!
How about hosting an in-person event
at the new hall!?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking events... that park is a must!
You can see the sea, so the location
is absolutely perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Yes, yes! I was thinking that spot was great too!
Everyone knows so much...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there are lots of people who aren't even from Tomakomai...
...............Ah.
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: This post... is a photo from my live concert.

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"Attended Tarumae-chan's local idol live!
Got super energized! Gonna look up Tomakomai
as soon as I get home!"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Post
text_block_list.text:
"Tomakomai is such an awesome place!
No wonder Tarumae-chan pushes it so hard~
Hope more people find out about it!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—! "Today's Tomakomai Quiz"...
This person is posting information about Tomakomai!
—Whoa, these are really great questions...!
choice_data_list: Looks like your feelings are really getting through.
It seems your passion is reaching everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: The "together with everyone" PR campaign should go great.
Our "all together" PR project looks like it'll succeed.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ......Fufu. Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—To think all the fans are now my partners
in promoting Tomakomai together... Ah!
choice_data_list: Hm, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
..."Ah~ Let's spread the word of Tomakomai together♪"
Could I use this for my next new song?
choice_data_list: ...Those are some very direct lyrics!
...That's certainly straight to the point!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, that's what makes it good!
Straightforward feelings right from the heart!
Clarity is what matters most in PR!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, if everyone knows this much,
I can't let myself be outdone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I need to get back to basics and study more!
As the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador,
I'm gonna give it another hearty push~!
